lessons_stated.value: To go long, don't take the more bullish index's (ES) signal alone; wait for the more bearish index (NQ) to also disrespect/invert its bearish gap
lessons_stated.ref: [04:30]-[05:45] 'not only do I need ES to disrespect that gap, I also need Nasdaq to disrespect its gap because Nasdaq is the more bearish index ... why should we listen to the more bullish index about why we should go higher' (rough)

lessons_stated.ref: [06:00]-[07:00], [14:15] 'we need ES [to break structure] to the downside as well' (rough)

lessons_stated.value: Before inverting a gap, price often prints a candle (hammer/inverted hammer) that looks like the gap is holding; don't get ahead of yourself
He doesn't like shorting right after all-time highs are taken and doesn't want to short prematurely
Take partials along the way; final take profit at the all-time highs
When the 5m is too volatile, he watches the 1m
lessons_stated.ref: [54:45] 'the five minute ... too volatile ... I just watch the one minute' (rough)

lessons_stated.value: Closing before the full target was fine: not worth the extra money and screen time once price inverted a gap to the downside
